title: Spending the royalties on a house next to the old church, and her tenants
summary: From $3,500 in royalties she kept $500 and sent $3,000 home. Her father bought the lot of the church next door and they built a rental house, where she keeps the rent at $65 a month for elderly tenants.

They used to come to me for every little thing that happened, if the sink started leaking the faucets would leak or something, you know, they'd tell me about it and I'd tell them, I got tired of it and I said, now the big things I don't mind doing like if the roof needs fixing or gutters or something like that. But I said, when these little household things get worn and the taps start leaking and that kind of stuff, I said, either you fix that stuff or I'll raise the rent because they've gone up on my taxes two or three times. And I haven't gone up on the rent, not once. And I know they are just sweet man. They sent me $5 for Christmas and $5 when I was in the hospital (Laughs).
